title: BG reading missed and silent mode
symptom: The 'BG reading missed' alarm does not override silent mode, so when the phone is on silent at night, missed readings are not alerted, potentially missing dangerous glucose drops. Some users also report that the alarm does not ring or vibrate even when the phone is not in silent mode.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; it is identified as a missing feature or bug in xDrip's alert handling for missed readings.
fix: No fix is provided in the thread; the issue is closed as a duplicate of issue #1147, suggesting users follow that issue for resolution.
evidence_quote: The problem is with the XDrip functionality, which doesn't allow to override silent mode for the "BG reading missing" alerts.
